title: Spinoza to Hegel: The Pantheism Controversy
dek: Of how a dramatist's private confession, published by a merchant's son to discredit reason, put a banned philosopher at the center of German thought.

panels.label: Idealists Told It
panels.text: Spinoza was the necessary starting point of modern philosophy, and German thought rose by absorbing and surpassing him.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Spinoza re-entered German debate through a quarrel over a dead man's reputation. Jacobi publicized him as a warning, and a generation read him as a revelation.

caption: Historical document
